hindi: अल्पभाषी, कम शब्दों में कहने वाला
definition: using very few words; concise to the point of seeming rude
example: His laconic reply was simply, "No."

hindi: वाक्पटु, प्रभावशाली ढंग से बोलने वाला
definition: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
example: She gave an eloquent speech on justice.

hindi: शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण, अधिक शब्द प्रयोग करने वाला
definition: using or expressed in more words than are needed
example: The report was dense and verbose.

definition: briefly and clearly expressed
example: Keep the summary succinct and to the point.

definition: a story with a hidden moral, political, or spiritual meaning
example: Animal Farm is an allegory of the Russian Revolution.

definition: written or spoken language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure
example: She wrote lucid, unadorned prose.

definition: the art of effective or persuasive speaking and writing
example: The essay was full of soaring rhetoric.

definition: a figure of speech describing one thing as another to imply a resemblance
example: "Time is a thief" is a metaphor.

definition: elaborately or excessively intricate in style
example: The invitation was written in florid, old-fashioned language.

hindi: सुस्पष्ट, आसानी से समझ आने वाला
definition: expressed clearly; easy to understand
example: The professor gave a lucid explanation of the theory.

definition: a spoken or written account of connected events; a story
example: The film weaves several narratives together.

definition: expression of meaning using language that signifies the opposite, often for humor
example: The irony was that the fire station burned down.

hindi: विस्तृत और उबाऊ, अनावश्यक रूप से लंबा
definition: tediously lengthy in speech or writing
example: His prolix memos exhausted the whole team.

definition: clear, logical, and convincing
example: She made a cogent argument for reform.

definition: a short amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person
example: He opened the talk with a personal anecdote.

definition: a mild word substituted for one considered too harsh or blunt
example: "Passed away" is a euphemism for "died."

hindi: सुव्यक्त, स्पष्ट रूप से बोलने वाला
definition: having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently
example: She is an articulate defender of the policy.

definition: the use of humor or exaggeration to criticize people's foolishness or vices
example: The show is a biting satire of office life.

definition: in exactly the same words as were used originally
example: He quoted the letter verbatim.

definition: concise and forcefully expressive
example: The critic is known for pithy one-line reviews.
